rationale: Lydia brings deep expertise in developer experience and technical education—skills that could amplify Louan's applied ML work in medical imaging by helping translate complex neuroimaging pipelines into accessible tools for clinicians and researchers. Louan's hands-on experience building production ML systems (Swin UNETRs, VICReg) in clinical settings complements Lydia's conviction that great tooling and clear technical communication unlock ecosystem adoption, and both are based in San Francisco.
intro_message: Lydia Hallie, meet Louan — a neuro-computational scientist at UCSF building applied ML pipelines for clinical neuroimaging who could benefit from your expertise in making complex technical work accessible to non-ML practitioners.
